observed_failure.reason: proposed deterministic operation has unsupported schema

root_cause: Semantic AI was told to bind an existing deterministic operation but was not given a machine-derived catalog of which repository refs actually satisfy the deterministic operation schema for the current evidence epoch. It therefore repurposed a non-operation authority/context ref and was correctly rejected.
repair: Derive an exact current-evidence-epoch deterministic-operation catalog from repository bytes.
Expose that catalog in the reasoning request and authoritative context.
Permit next_deterministic_operation_ref only from that catalog with exact operation-name match.
Explicitly forbid repurposing evidence/context/freeze/routing authority files as deterministic operations.
When no matching operation exists, require explicit implementation AI, exact new-data gate, or another legally routed action.
